llc.formation_notes: $100 online / $110 in office. Publication requirement: notice of organization must be published three successive weeks in a legal newspaper of general circulation near the designated office, and proof of publication filed with the SOS (Affidavit/Proof of Publication filing $25 online / $30 in office). Newspaper cost extra. LB1014 (2026 session) proposed an electronic publication option; status not verified.

annual_report.name: Biennial Report
annual_report.due: odd-numbered years by April 1 (delinquent June 16, then administrative dissolution)
annual_report.late_penalty: Administrative dissolution after June 16; late reinstatement $500

state_tax_on_llc.name: Proof of Publication filing fee (one-time)
state_tax_on_llc.applies: every domestic LLC after newspaper publication
state_tax_on_llc.notes: $25 online / $30 in office, plus newspaper charges

personal_exemption.notes: Nonrefundable personal exemption credit $176 per exemption (2026).

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: None. Top rate falls to 4.55% in 2026 (5.20% in 2025) and to 3.99% from 2027 under current law.

estimated_tax.notes: Penalty avoided if payments total at least 90% of current-year tax, 100% of prior-year tax, or 110% if prior-year AGI over $150,000.

unemployment_2026.notes: Non-construction new employer 1.25%, construction 5.40%; wage base $9,000 (categories 1-19), $24,000 for category 20 (max-rate) employers.

notable: Rate cut: top individual rate 4.55% for 2026 (5.20% in 2025), scheduled 3.99% for 2027 (https://revenue.nebraska.gov/sites/default/files/doc/research/chronology/4-607table1.pdf)
New LLCs must publish a notice for three successive weeks in a newspaper (https://nebraskalegislature.gov/laws/statutes.php?statute=21-193)
No LLC franchise tax; biennial report only in odd years (https://sos.nebraska.gov/business-services/annualbiennial-reporting)
